Resolves #19916

A child whose `afterSetMounted` throws no longer stops `syncVnodeTree`. Each child's mount is isolated, and the error is logged with the component id. The later children still get their vnodes, the unmount pass runs and the parent adopts its own vnode, so the flight resolves and the next update inserts nothing a second time. The same file already isolates callbacks this way (`initVnode callback rejection failed`, `vdom callback rejection failed`).

Evidence: L3 (a browser e2e in the Engine tier and a unit arm, both red with `dev`'s `VdomLifecycle.mjs` and green at head) → L3 required (AC-2). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/vdom/VdomLifecycle.spec.mjs` "a throwing mount hook leaves its later siblings synced and the parent adopted (#19916)". With `dev`'s file: 1 failed, 23 passed; the flight is rejected, both later siblings stay unmounted with no vnode, and the parent never adopts its children. At head: 24 passed |
| AC-2 | CI-covered (e2e-engine): `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/MountHookIsolation.spec.mjs` "resolves its render and mounts its siblings, so no later update inserts a node twice". With `dev`'s file, the next update duplicates the thrower and both siblings, realworld2's symptom; at head it passes |
| AC-3 | Both arms assert the logged arguments: message, component id and error. The e2e also asserts that the line reaches the page console |

## Deltas from ticket
- **Two shapes.** When the thrower is a direct child of the updated component, `dev` produces no duplicate: that component's next update fails in the VDom worker (`createDeltas() must be called for the same node`) instead. When the updated component inserts a container whose item throws, as in realworld2, the container's next update inserts its items again. The unit arm covers the direct shape and the e2e the nested one; the e2e checks the next update of both the container and the updated component.
- **The nested log names the container.** There the throw surfaces through the container's own mount cascade, so the line carries the container's id. The logged stack still points at the thrower's `afterSetMounted`.
- **CI selection.** The spec sits in `rendering/`, so it is listed in `RUN_PATHS` for the engine e2e tier.
- **Not in scope: the unmount pass has the same escape.** A throwing unmount hook in `unmountRemovedChildren` rejects the update and leaves a later removed sibling mounted with a stale vnode (probe at this head). `list.Base` unsubscribes `Navigator` on unmount, so a missing addon hits it too. Captured as a defect-note for triage.

It passed 5/5 with `--repeat-each=5` before the rebase onto `4867b61f89`, which changes SCSS only.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: In the nested container case (`MountHookIsolation.spec.mjs` and `realworld2`'s `HomeContainer`), `Neo.container.Base#afterSetMounted` (`src/container/Base.mjs:203-213`) synchronously cascades `items[i].mounted = value` inside `super.afterSetMounted(value, oldValue)` when `syncVnodeTree` mounts the outer container (`i = 1`), before `syncVnodeTree`'s flat `childComponents` loop reaches the nested items (`i = 2..N`). That cascade has two subtle consequences beyond naming the outer container in the `console.error` log: (1) each nested item's `afterSetMounted(true, false)` runs while its own `_vnode` is still `null` and `vnodeInitialized` is still `false` (until `syncVnodeTree` reaches that item's index in `childComponents`), and (2) when a nested item throws inside `container.Base#afterSetMounted`, the exception unwinds out of `super.afterSetMounted(value, oldValue)` on the parent container (and any newly-mounted ancestor containers), skipping the parent container's `afterVnodeSync(deltas)` (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1211`) as well as any container subclass logic after `super.afterSetMounted` (such as `toolbar.Base#wireFocusSubject` at `src/toolbar/Base.mjs:177`, `grid.Container#addResizeObserver` / `scrollManager.mounted = value` at `src/grid/Container.mjs:572-578`, `dialog.Base#syncTrapFocus` at `src/dialog/Base.mjs:285`, or `Workspace#onDockZoneDocumentChange` at `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:1913`), while the throwing item itself already has `_mounted = true` and still executes `afterVnodeSync(deltas)` at its own loop index. This is pre-existing behavior in `container.Base#afterSetMounted` outside `#19916`'s `syncVnodeTree` scope, worth pairing with the unmount-pass escape note when evaluating container mount cascade isolation.
